import csv
mid='aacde83b-cb33-52a4-af23-15f624ca5b6a'
top='8a6a2103-e15c-58ff-a998-706690ba7cf8'
from collections import defaultdict
d=defaultdict(dict)
for row in csv.DictReader(open(VALUES_CSV)):
    if row['timeseries_id'] in (mid,top) and row['timestamp'].startswith('2018-10-11'):
        h=row['timestamp'][11:13]
        d[row['timeseries_id']][h]=float(row['value'])
def mean(ts):
    hrs=[f'{h:02d}' for h in range(8,19)]
    vals=[v for h in hrs if h in d[ts] for v in [d[ts][h]]]
    return sum(vals)/len(vals), len(vals)
mm,nm=mean(mid); mt,nt=mean(top)
print(mm,mt,mm-mt,nm,nt)
